title: Index de gravité pour Eosinophilic Esophagitis (I-SEE)
abbreviations: Index of Severity for Eosinophilic Esophagitis (I-SEE)
formula:
The I-SEE Score is calculated by the addition of the selected points:

| Variable | Points | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Symptoms and complications | | |
| Symptoms | None | 0 |
| Weekly | 1 | |
| Daily | 2 | |
| Multiple times per day or disrupting social functioning | 4 | |
| Food impaction | None | 0 |
| Food impaction with ER visit or endoscopy (patient ≥18 years) | 2 | |
| Food impaction with ER visit or endoscopy (patient <18 years) | 4 | |
| Hospitalization due to EoE | No | 0 |
| Yes | 4 | |
| Esophageal perforation | No | 0 |
| Yes | 15 | |
| Malnutrition | None | 0 |
| Malnutrition with body mass <5th percentile or decreased growth trajectory | 15 | |
| Inflammation | None | 0 |
| Persistent inflammation requiring elemental formula, or systemic corticosteroid, or immunomodulatory 1 treatments | 15 | |
| Inflammatory features | | |
| Edema, furrows, and/or exudates | None | 0 |
| Localized | 1 | |
| Diffuse | 2 | |
| Eosinophil count 2 | <15 eos/hpf | 0 |
| 15-60 eos/hpf | 1 | |
| >60 eos/hpf | 2 | |
| Fibrostenotic features | | |
| Rings, strictures | None | 0 |
| Present, but endoscope passes easily | 1 | |
| Present, but requires dilation or a snug fit when passing a standard endoscope 3 | 2 | |
| Cannot pass standard upper endoscope; repeated dilations (in an adult ≥18 years); or any dilation (in a child <18 years) | 15 | |
| BZH or LPF (or DEC / SEA if no LP) | No | 0 |
| Yes | 2 | |

^1^Immunomodulatory medications can include biologics, azathioprine/6MP, or other immune-targeted treatments.

^2^The peak eosinophil count should be specifically quantified both for diagnosis and to allow monitoring; however, this table uses thresholds and ranges.

^3^Seen with a 10–14 mm esophagus; esophageal diameter can be measured by balloon-sizing, dilation effect, barium esophagram, etc.

how_to_use.why:
- Il existe peu d’outils permettant d’évaluer la gravité des symptômes et de la maladie.
- Doit être utilisé dans le cadre d’un plan de traitement complet.
how_to_use.when: Peut être utilisé lors de la visite initiale et des visites ultérieures chez l’enfant et l’adulte atteints d’œsophagite à éosinophiles (EoE).

next_steps.management:
- Des scores élevés indiquent une maladie plus sévère. Travaillez avec votre patient pour suivre l’évolution et apporter des modifications diététiques si nécessaire, discuter d’un traitement médicamenteux le cas échéant et envisager une dilatation œsophagienne si justifiée.
- Pour plus d’informations sur la prise en charge diététique dans l’EoE, veuillez consulter cet article de [Chang et al, 2023](https://www.cghjournal.org/article/S1542-3565(23)00186-6/fulltext).

more_info:
Interprétation :

| Score I-SEE | Sévérité de l'EoE |
| --- | --- |
| <1 | Inactive |
| 1-6 | Légère |
| 7-14 | Modérée |
| ≥15 | Sévère |
